rules.name: scan-damaged-text-step1
rules.sql: WITH counts AS ( SELECT n.nspname AS schema_name, c.relname AS table_name, CAST(c.reltuples AS bigint) AS approx_rows, CASE WHEN c.reltuples > :maxRows THEN NULL ELSE CAST(CAST((xpath('/row/n/text()', query_to_xml( format('select count(*) as n from %I.%I t where t::text like %L', n.nspname, c.relname, '%?%'), false, true, ''))) [1] AS text) AS bigint) END AS rows_with_question_mark FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'opera' AND c.relkind = 'r' ) SELECT counts.schema_name, counts.table_name, counts.approx_rows, counts.rows_with_question_mark, CASE WHEN counts.rows_with_question_mark > 0 THEN (SELECT string_agg(CAST(x AS text), ' ||| ') FROM unnest(xpath('/table/row/s/text()', query_to_xml( format('select left(t::text, 220) as s from %I.%I t where t::text like %L limit 3', counts.schema_name, counts.table_name, '%?%'), false, false, ''))) AS x) END AS examples FROM counts ORDER BY counts.rows_with_question_mark DESC NULLS LAST, counts.table_name

WITH counts AS ( SELECT n.nspname AS schema_name, c.relname AS table_name, CAST(c.reltuples AS bigint) AS approx_rows, CASE WHEN c.reltuples > :maxRows THEN NULL ELSE CAST(CAST((xpath('/row/n/text()', query_to_xml( format('select count(*) as n from %I.%I t where t::text like %L', n.nspname, c.relname, '%?%'), false, true, ''))) [1] AS text) AS bigint) END AS rows_with_question_mark FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'opera_backup_04_10' AND c.relkind = 'r' ) SELECT counts.schema_name, counts.table_name, counts.approx_rows, counts.rows_with_question_mark, CASE WHEN counts.rows_with_question_mark > 0 THEN (SELECT string_agg(CAST(x AS text), ' ||| ') FROM unnest(xpath('/table/row/s/text()', query_to_xml( format('select left(t::text, 220) as s from %I.%I t where t::text like %L limit 3', counts.schema_name, counts.table_name, '%?%'), false, false, ''))) AS x) END AS examples FROM counts ORDER BY counts.rows_with_question_mark DESC NULLS LAST, counts.table_name
